verdict.rationale: Jina Reader documents on-demand URL-to-Markdown fetching, search, structured extraction and caching. Nothing in the evidence shows page-change monitoring, diffing, recurring schedules, or notifications or webhooks when content changes. A one-off fetch, or the 5-minute cache, is not a monitoring capability, so this applicable axis is unsupported.

support.subject: As a data-engineer, I can monitor target pages for content changes, such as price or listing updates, and get notified as they happen
